$comment: Template — best-effort mapping of TraceLayer hooks to OpenCode. OpenCode hook schemas evolve; verify the exact event names, matcher syntax, and output handling against your OpenCode version before release. Core `trace hook` protocol is stable; this adapter owns harness serialization.

hooks.command: uv run trace hook session-start --format json
uv run trace hook prompt-context --format json
uv run trace hook pre-mutation --format json
uv run trace hook post-mutation --format json
uv run trace hook post-batch --format json
uv run trace hook stop --format json
